title: Warm-up 1: Make a Passkey
text: Alex creates a passkey for shop.example. The website asks, the authenticator makes a key pair, and the website stores half of it.
held: The website holds a public key. The private key never left the authenticator.

cards.label: Send a fresh random challenge, with your site's name
Send the same challenge you send everyone
cards.why: A challenge everyone shares can be answered once and reused forever. It has to be new and random each time.

cards.label: Make a new key pair for shop.example and keep the private key
Reuse the key pair you made for another site
cards.why: One key for two sites links the accounts and shares their fate. A passkey belongs to exactly one site.

cards.label: Store the public key against Alex's account
Ask the authenticator for the private key too, for safekeeping
cards.why: The private key never leaves the authenticator. A site that holds it has rebuilt the password database.
